description_en: Retrieves a list of authorization details for the menus in a BI portal
description_zh: 获取数据门户菜单的授权详情列表
name: ListPortalMenuAuthorization

parameters.help_en: The ID of the BI portal
parameters.name: data_portal_id

Result.description_en: A list of authorization details for the BI portal menus
Result.description_zh: 门户菜单的授权详情列表

items.description_en: A list of authorization details for the portal menus
items.description_zh: 门户菜单的授权详情列表

MenuId.description_en: The ID of the leaf-node menu in the BI portal
MenuId.description_zh: 数据门户的叶子节点菜单ID

Receivers.description_en: The details of the authorization objects for the menu
Receivers.description_zh: 菜单所授权的对象详情

items.description_en: The details of the authorization objects for the menu
items.description_zh: 菜单所授权的对象详情

AuthPointsValue.description_en:
The authorization type for the menu. Valid values:

1: View

11: Edit

3: Export and view

10: Manage data entry
AuthPointsValue.description_zh:
菜单授权类型。取值范围：

1：查看
11：编辑
3：导出和查看
10 ：管理填报数据

ReceiverId.description_en:
The ID of the authorization object.

If the authorization object is an organization, this ID is the organization ID.

If the authorization object is a workspace, this ID is the workspace ID
ReceiverId.description_zh:
授权对象ID。

授权对象类型为组织时，该ID对应组织ID
授权对象类型为空间时，该ID对应空间ID

ReceiverType.description_en:
The type of the authorization object. Valid values:

0: User

1: User group

2: Organization

3: Workspace
ReceiverType.description_zh:
授权对象类型。取值范围：

0：用户
1：用户组
2：组织
3：空间

ShowOnlyWithAccess.description_en:
Indicates whether the menu is visible only to authorized users. Valid values:

true: The menu is visible only to authorized users.

false: The menu is visible to all users
ShowOnlyWithAccess.description_zh:
是否仅授权可见。取值范围：

true：仅授权可见
false：都可见
ShowOnlyWithAccess.title_en:
菜单授权类型。取值范围：
● 1：查看
● 11：编辑
● 3：导出和查看
ShowOnlyWithAccess.title_zh:
菜单授权类型。取值范围：
● 1：查看
● 11：编辑
● 3：导出和查看

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:

true: The request was successful.

false: The request failed
Success.description_zh:
是否请求成功。取值范围：

true：请求成功
false：请求失败
